dataset: RILEM TC 304-ADC interlaboratory study — mechanical properties of 3D-printed concrete (ILS-mech)
attribution: Bos, F., Robens-Radermacher, A., Muthukrishnan, S., Versteegen, J., Wolfs, R., Santhanam, M., Menna, C., & Mechtcherine, V. / RILEM TC 304-ADC (2024). Database of the RILEM TC 304-ADC interlaboratory study on mechanical properties of 3D printed concrete (ILS-mech) [Dataset]. Zenodo. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.12200570. CC BY 4.0.
storage_medium: relational openBIS-exported SQLite (2024-06-21_openbis.db, 31 tables/views), one row per tested specimen

fidelity.method: hand-curated relational→flat (denormalize + aggregate mean/stddev/n); automated open3dcp-ingest score pending a SQLite reader (follow-up)

build_cmd: python build/extract.py <2024-06-21_openbis.db downloaded from the DOI>
